name: plan-template-uncompiled
argv: Input is UTF-8 SMT-LIB2 text intended for QF-style solving.
Solvers may return "unknown" within the per-step timeout; that is an honest outcome, not an error.

assumptions: Input is UTF-8 SMT-LIB2 text intended for QF-style solving.
Solvers may return "unknown" within the per-step timeout; that is an honest outcome, not an error.

input.smt_lib:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(set-info :source "i186 user-e2e scenario A: integers x,y in [0,1] cannot sum to 4")
(set-info :status unsat)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(declare-fun y () Int)
(assert (>= x 0))
(assert (<= x 1))
(assert (>= y 0))
(assert (<= y 1))
(assert (>= (+ x y) 4))
(check-sat)
(exit)
